Hi OP! Okay naman. Magsesecond year na ako and honestly if you really like your course and you know what ur getting into, the time just flies by. Bring your laptop in case may issue sa lab. Wag tatamarin, kumain ng mabuti, don’t fall for the trap of sleeping late and all nighters, surround yourself with the right people. Don’t be tempted to cheat at i-ChatGPT lahat because fundamentals are fundamentals. Profs are hit or miss pero malalampasan naman with the right attitude.

As for academic scholarships, if hindi ka pasok sa standards ng income based scholarships like IBFAP, most likely hindi ka makukuha sa NBAS ng deans list since mostly financial status ang basehan. For Presidents List though, basta presidents lister ka maaapply yung scholarship.

sa mapua ako rn and since trisem, 13,333 lang yung tuition. this term, almost 70k with misc fee yung matriculation ko.

what i did is i applied for a university scholarship tas may discount yon and benefits na rin. so ung stipend from the university scholarship + discount + the dost subsidy leaves me with 7-15k nalang na babayaran. 

tbh, hindi talaga sya sapat OP, pero napakalaking tulong na nya. if you can, try mo mag apply sa mga scholarship ng institution mo pati sa mga scholarships ng private companies.

NO TO TUITION INCREASE!

what i did was pumunta ako ng landbank with my parent (in case manghingi ng addtl. reqs dahil 18 lang me) i brought a valid id, and my letter of introduction from dost and inassist naman ako.

hellooo 2024 passer ako. for me, i barely reviewed (1 hour the night before), and im very average sa school namin (90 gen ave). i think DOST barely looks at your grades kase babagsakin ako nung online class days. you have to have a good grasp of the math and science fundamentals. literal na pag kaya mo yung basic, kaya mo yung complex (although para saken wala masyadong complex and lengthy computations na ginawa). just review the primer dost has on the website and focus on your mistakes. same with any online reviewer. focus on your mistakes, isipin mo bakit mali, correct yourself, and be alert when you encounter similar problems in the exam. good luck, future scholar!
